_comment: Fellegi-Sunter weights learned via 5-fold CV on BenchRec cash dataset (scratch/calc_weights.py). desc weights are 0.0 because description text in BenchRec cash data has near-zero discriminative power — amount and date dominate. Jaro-Winkler on descriptions is still applied at Tier 1 (>=0.85 threshold) independently of these weights.
